callees.name: Exception.__init__
callees.pre_condition: message is a non-empty string containing the human-readable description of the JSON-RPC error, produced by converting the error dict to its string representation via str(error).
callees.post_condition: The base Exception class records message as the exception's description. When the exception instance is converted to a string (via str() or repr()), this message is returned. No exception is raised by the base initializer itself.
